data.one_liner: Dart SDK for AG-UI protocol supporting event-based communication and SSE streaming.
data.what_it_does: Provides strongly-typed client implementations for connecting to AG-UI compatible agent servers. It enables real-time event streaming, state management, tool interactions, and multimodal input.
use_when: You need to connect Dart apps to AG-UI compatible agent servers
You require server-sent event (SSE) streaming for LLM or AI agent interactions
avoid_when: You are building standard REST or GraphQL applications without AI agent protocols
You need an on-device machine learning model instead of a remote protocol client
strengths: Dart-native with full type safety and null safety
Comprehensive support for tool calls, state snapshots, activity, and reasoning events
Efficient event decoding with backpressure handling
weaknesses: Requires specific AG-UI compliant server architecture on the backend
Narrow domain focus limited entirely to the AG-UI protocol
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and initialize AgUiClient with a base URL.
